name: novotion-sales-lead-portal
description: Novotion Services LLP - Sales & Lead Management Desktop Portal
author: Novotion Services LLP

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix frontend && npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix functions
scripts.build:all: npm run build:frontend && npm run build:backend && npm run build:functions
scripts.dist:win: npm run build:frontend && electron-builder --win nsis --publish never
scripts.desktop:dist: npm run build:frontend && electron-builder --win nsis --publish never
scripts.desktop:publish: npm run build:frontend && electron-builder --win nsis --publish always
scripts.stage:releases: powershell -Command "if (Test-Path release) { New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path frontend/dist/releases; Copy-Item -Path release/*.exe,release/latest.yml,release/*.blockmap -Destination frontend/dist/releases -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue }"
scripts.deploy:hosting: npm run build:frontend && firebase deploy --only hosting
scripts.deploy:functions: npm run build:functions && firebase deploy --only functions
scripts.deploy: npm run build:frontend && npm run build:functions && firebase deploy
scripts.deploy:all: npm run build:frontend && npm run desktop:dist && npm run stage:releases && npm run build:functions && firebase deploy
